old_man.name: Elder Rowan
old_man.greeting: Welcome back, traveler. The road has been dangerous, but we are alive.

topics.response: We were farmers, merchants, refugees... The Gravekeeper rise drove us here. These tents are all we have left. But you — you fight. That gives us hope.
The graveyard to the east... The dead do not rest easy there. Something ancient keeps them rising. Be careful if you go back.

cute_girl.name: Lina
cute_girl.greeting: Oh! You fixed up the camp! I am... I am Lina. Thank you for making this place safer.

topics.text: How did you end up here?
topics.response: I was a baker daughter in the city. When the dead started walking, we fled. My family... I do not know if they made it. But I am grateful to be alive.

topics.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
topics.response: If you could clear the graveyard, maybe we could rebuild the city road. People would start coming back. Please... be careful out there.

blacksmith.name: Garret the Blacksmith
blacksmith.greeting: Hmph. Another traveler. If you need weapons forged, you have come to the right place. I used to make plows and horseshoes. Now it is all swords and shields.

topics.text: Can you forge me something special?
topics.response: I can forge decent blades, but the real materials... they are buried in the graveyard. Bring me rare metal and I will make you something legendary.

topics.text: How did you end up here?
topics.response: I was the finest smith in the valley. When the dead rose, my forge was the first thing they destroyed. I have been tempering steel and tempering my patience ever since.

tavern_keeper.name: Mira the Tavern Keeper
tavern_keeper.greeting: Welcome, weary soul! Sit down, have a drink. Well... we are out of ale. But I have got stories, and those are free.

topics.response: Travelers say the Gravekeeper was not always a monster. Some say he was a good man once, until something broke inside him. Tragic, really.

topics.text: This place used to be lively, huh?
topics.response: Lively? It was the heart of the village! Singing, dancing, feasts every fortnight. Now it is just me and the rats. But we keep the lights on. Hope is important.

worried_refugee.name: Anxious Refugee
worried_refugee.greeting: *shivers* Did you hear that last night? Groaning from the graveyard. They are getting closer every day...

topics.response: The nights are getting colder. My children are sick. I do not know how much longer we can survive here. But at least you fight for us. That means something.

topics.text: Are the zombies really getting closer?
topics.response: Every night I hear them. Scratching at the walls, moaning. Elder Rowan says we are safe, but I have seen them in the treeline. They are watching us.

weather_watcher.name: Old Sarah
weather_watcher.greeting: Rain is coming. My bones always know. *looks at the sky* Dark clouds gathering over the graveyard...

topics.text: What do you think about the weather?
topics.response: Storm is brewing. Good for the crops — if we had any left. Bad for morale. People get anxious when the sky goes dark. Reminds them of... you know.

topics.text: Tell me about the old days.
topics.response: Oh honey, I remember when this was all green fields. Markets full of flowers, children laughing. Now look at us. Huddled around campfires, jumping at shadows.
